description: This file defines API endpoints for managing prescriptions in a medical prescription backend system. It includes routes to generate unique prescription codes, create new prescriptions, list prescriptions based on user roles, retrieve specific prescription details, generate QR payloads, and update prescription status. It leverages FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and includes role-based access controls.

methods.name: dict generate_code(db: Session = Depends(get_db), length: int = Query(default=8, ge=6, le=16))
methods.description: Generates a unique prescription code that is not used in the database.

methods.name: PrescriptionRead create_prescription( payload: PrescriptionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new prescription, restricted to doctors and admins.

methods.name: List[PrescriptionRead] list_prescriptions( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by status"), doctor_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Admin-only: filter by doctor_id"), pharmacist_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Admin-only: filter by pharmacist_id"), )
methods.description: Lists prescriptions filtered based on user role and optional filters.

methods.name: PrescriptionRead get_prescription( prescription_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific prescription's details if the user has access.

methods.name: dict get_qr_payload( prescription_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns a QR payload for the specified prescription if the user has access.

methods.name: PrescriptionRead update_status( prescription_id: int, payload: PrescriptionStatusUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates the status of a prescription with role-based restrictions.
